title: 100kW PCS + 150kWh LiFePO4 Battery Storage in the USA
summary: A 100kW PCS with 150kWh of LiFePO4 storage, installed in the United States.
challenge: PCS-based commercial projects need sizing, interconnection review and safety documentation settled before equipment is ordered, and each of those constrains the others.
solution: A 100kW PCS paired with a 150kWh LiFePO4 bank, configured around the site's demand profile and backup requirement.
